name: rot90
comment: Sig: r = rot90(A[,k]). 90-deg CCW rotation (type-agnostic). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: extended to CELL/STRING (earlier) AND now CHAR matrices / LOGICAL / COMPLEX / single (the 2-D/3-D POD path was still DOUBLE-only and threw 'Not a double array'; reuses the existing byte-copy kernels). rot90([1 2;3 4])=[2 4;1 3]; rot90({1 2;3 4})={2 4;1 3}; rot90(['ab';'cd'])=['bd';'ac'] (m11='b'=98); rot90(['ab';'cd'],2)=['dc';'ba']; rot90(logical([1 0;0 0]))=[0 0;1 0]; rot90([1+1i 2;3 4])(1,1)=2+0i. k!=1 forms covered in gtest. namespace=builtin. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
